title: Imperfect and Pluperfect Subjunctive
summary: Use forms like se eu fosse and se eu tivesse feito for hypothetical and past unreal situations.

sections.heading: Imperfect subjunctive
sections.body: The **imperfeito do subjuntivo** appears after expressions of desire, doubt, emotion, and conditions referring to the past or hypothetical present. It is built from the third-person plural preterite stem: fizeram → fizesse, foram → fosse.

examples.pt: Se eu tivesse tempo, viajaria mais.
examples.en: If I had time, I would travel more.

examples.pt: Era importante que todos soubessem a verdade.
examples.en: It was important that everyone know the truth.

sections.heading: Common forms
sections.body: Regular verbs use endings like **falasse, comesse, abrisse**. Essential irregulars include **fosse** (ser/ir), **tivesse** (ter), **fizesse** (fazer), **pudesse** (poder), **quisesse** (querer), **viesse** (vir).

examples.pt: Se ela falasse comigo, eu explicaria.
examples.en: If she talked to me, I would explain.
If we could, we would help.

examples.pt: Queria que eles fossem mais pacientes.
examples.en: I wanted them to be more patient.

sections.heading: Pluperfect subjunctive
sections.body: Use **tivesse + past participle** for actions that would have happened before another past or hypothetical action. The participle is invariable.

examples.pt: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria ligado.
examples.en: If I had known, I would have called.

examples.pt: Ela agiu como se nada tivesse acontecido.
examples.en: She acted as if nothing had happened.

examples.pt: Gostaria que vocês tivessem avisado antes.
examples.en: I wish you had warned me earlier.

keyPoints: Imperfect subjunctive handles hypothetical or past-dependent uncertainty.
It often pairs with the conditional: se eu tivesse, eu faria.
The participle is invariable in tivesse feito.
